name: Exp_ColorMaRsi-Trigger_Duplex
summary: This EA trades based on a duplex (dual) signal system combining colored Moving Average trend direction with RSI momentum triggers. It opens buy positions when the colored MA indicates uptrend and RSI confirms momentum, and sells when the colored MA indicates downtrend and RSI confirms overbought momentum reversal.
summary_zh: 该EA基于双重信号系统进行交易，结合彩色均线趋势方向与RSI动量触发器。当彩色均线指示上升趋势且RSI确认动量时开多仓，当彩色均线指示下降趋势且RSI确认超买卖动量反转时开空仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重确认机制：彩色均线（ColorMa）提供趋势方向判断，RSI指标提供动量触发信号，两者结合形成入场条件。入场条件为：多头入场需要彩色均线变为上升趋势颜色且RSI从超卖区域上穿触发线；空头入场需要彩色均线变为下降趋势颜色且RSI从超买区域下穿触发线。出场条件包括：反向信号出现时平仓、止损止盈触发、或RSI背离时退出。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，该EA依赖止损止盈比例控制风险，但未实现基于账户余额或风险百分比的动态资金管理。双工（Duplex）设计意味着可能同时处理多空信号或在两个时间框架上运行。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual confirmation mechanism: a colored Moving Average (ColorMa) provides trend direction assessment, while the RSI indicator provides momentum trigger signals, and the combination of both forms the entry conditions. Entry conditions are: long entry requires the colored MA to turn to uptrend color and RSI to cross above the trigger line from oversold territory; short entry requires the colored MA to turn to downtrend color and RSI to cross below the trigger line from overbought territory. Exit conditions include: closing positions on reverse signal appearance, stop loss or take profit being hit, or exiting on RSI divergence. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic position adjustment mechanism detected. Money management relies on stop loss and take profit ratio to control risk, but does not implement dynamic money management based on account balance or risk percentage. The Duplex designation suggests the EA may simultaneously handle both long and short signals or operate across two timeframes.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points (unused; buy TP follows MA value)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 双重确认机制降低虚假信号，彩色均线加RSI动量过滤提高了入场质量
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性强，便于优化和回测
Duplex双工设计允许同时捕捉多空机会，提高了市场适应性
pros_en: Dual confirmation mechanism reduces false signals; colored MA plus RSI momentum filtering improves entry quality
Clear and understandable strategy logic with adjustable parameters facilitates optimization and backtesting
Duplex design allows capturing both long and short opportunities, improving market adaptability
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动性调整风险敞口
未发现点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不必要的亏损交易
彩色均线在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号，导致反复开仓平仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
No spread filter mechanism detected, which may generate unnecessary losing trades in high-spread environments
Colored MA tends to produce frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to repeated open/close cycles
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，使风险管理适应市场波动性变化
添加点差过滤和震荡市识别模块，避免在不适合的市场条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit mechanism to adapt risk management to changing market volatility
Add spread filter and ranging market identification module to avoid opening positions in unsuitable market conditions

risk_points: 固定手数交易未根据账户净值动态调整，存在过度交易风险
震荡市场中均线频繁变色可能导致连续止损
risk_points_en: Fixed lot trading without dynamic adjustment based on account equity poses overtrading risk
Frequent color changes of MA in ranging markets may lead to consecutive stop losses
